what: One read-only open of the live shared index, via the tool's own open path
command: BB_DATA_DIR=.bb-data bun -e "BrainDatabase.getRawInstance(getProjectId(cwd), { readonly: true }); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM brain_symbol WHERE project_id=?"
result: SQLiteError: unable to open database file (repeated twice, seconds apart)
control: The same file copied byte-for-byte (cp --reflink=auto) to validation/tools/bb_patterns/bbdata/t2b opened read-only and answered 310,423 symbols
conclusion: Not a handler defect: the live index was in a state where a byte-read-only open was refused while the identical bytes are readable. Recorded as a blocked live leg; the lane copy carries the dbUnchanged:true latency measurement.
